# bugs #2287: mcs51 --stack-auto: missing stores to a global in static inline functions that read a va_list

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/2287/
- Category: [Already fixed in trunk](../../fixed-upstream.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Close as fixed, and remove the mcs51 condition in gcc-torture-execute-stdarg-5.c.in. The revision is not identified.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The test of the ticket passes on r17176 for mcs51 with `--stack-auto` once its run-time check is
enabled. The regression suite still skips that check.

The code of the attachment is in trunk as
`support/regression/tests/gcc-torture-execute-stdarg-5.c.in`. The regression suite builds one case
with `static inline` and one case without it from this file. In `testTortureExecute` an `#elif`
removes the assertions when `__SDCC_mcs51`, `__SDCC_STACK_AUTO`, and `INLINED_yes` are defined and
`__SDCC_USE_XSTACK` is not, which is the configuration of the ticket. The condition has this form
since r9288. On r17176 the suite therefore runs the 12 assertions of the case without
`static inline` and none of the `static inline` case, for mcs51-small-stack-auto and for
mcs51-large-stack-auto.

For this entry the `#elif` and its comment line were removed in a copy of the file. Both cases were
built from the copy with a compiler built from r17176, with the options and the framework objects
of the regression suite, and run in uCsim. The `static inline` case passes its 12 assertions with
`--model-small --stack-auto` and with `--model-large --stack-auto`. The case without
`static inline` passes them as well. The copy was not run for other ports or with `--xstack`.

In the assembly of the `static inline` case, `f2` contains the code of `f2i`, and the stores to `y`
are present. With the small model there is a store after each of the three statements. With the
large model the value is computed across the three statements and stored once after the third. The
sixth and the eleventh comment contain code from 2014 that lacks these stores.

`gcc-torture-execute-stdarg-4.c` does not cover the report. r9052, the workaround for this bug,
removed `static inline` from its functions.

## Fixed by

The revision was not identified. The log of trunk has no commit after r9052 that names this
ticket, and no older revision was built for a comparison. A maintainer confirmed the defect in the
sixth and seventh comments with assembly and iCode dumps from 2014.
